updates.title: CVE-2026-69851: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should apply available security updates to protect against unauthorized privilege elevation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69836: Microsoft Entra ID Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID permits unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely over the network. This critical vulnerability requires immediate patching to prevent potential account compromise and lateral movement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Sensitive Data Protection in Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention now extends to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat to block external web searches containing sensitive information. This real-time control helps organizations prevent accidental data leakage when users interact with AI-powered search features.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: File Quarantine Action for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: A new File Quarantine enforcement action in DLP automatically moves flagged files to admin-controlled quarantine locations, instantly revoking user access while preserving content for investigation. This strengthens data protection by enabling immediate containment of sensitive content violations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips now appear natively in Outlook for Mac, alerting users in real time when emails contain sensitive information that violates policies. Users can remove non-compliant recipients or request policy overrides directly from the mail tip interface.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Enhanced audit logging for Microsoft Purview portal access now provides detailed visibility into role and scoped-role authorization decisions. Admins can more easily troubleshoot access issues and monitor who accessed what within Purview.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: User-Owned SharePoint Embedded Containers as Data Source
updates.summary: eDiscovery capabilities now allow legal and compliance teams to include user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers (hosting content from Loop, Copilot Pages, and Copilot Notebooks) in their discovery scope. This expands the data sources available for investigation and litigation holds.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery: Customer-Managed Keys for Direct Export
updates.summary: eDiscovery direct export now supports customer-managed encryption keys (CMK) alongside Microsoft-managed encryption, giving organizations full control over key management for sensitive exported data. This enhancement strengthens compliance posture for highly regulated industries.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Triage Agent Insights in Microsoft Defender XDR
updates.summary: Data Security Triage Agent summaries and categorizations for DLP alerts are now surfaced within Microsoft Defender XDR, centralizing alert investigation and reducing context switching for security teams. This integration enhances visibility into DLP incidents across the security platform.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Reasoning Trace and Confidence Score for Triage Agent Decisions
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent now provides confidence scores and explainable reasoning traces alongside alert recommendations, enabling SOC teams to evaluate agent reliability without falling back to manual review. This transparency builds trust in automation while maintaining audit accountability.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention Based on Last Accessed Date
updates.summary: Retention policies can now trigger based on when a file in SharePoint or OneDrive was last accessed by a user, enabling more granular and intelligent data lifecycle management. This helps organizations retain active data while safely disposing of stale content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Admins will soon be able to configure retention policies for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items stored in user mailboxes, enabling versioning and preservation of Copilot conversation history for security investigations and compliance audits. This extends lifecycle governance to AI-generated content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Hard Delete via Priority Cleanup Workflows
updates.summary: Compliance admins will gain the ability to permanently hard-delete content in SharePoint and OneDrive through secure priority cleanup workflows with multi-stage approval gates. This addresses regulatory requirements for irreversible data disposal while protecting against accidental deletion.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized users to escalate privileges over the network. Organizations running on-premises SharePoint should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized privilege elevation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering Vulnerability
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization controls in Microsoft Office SharePoint enable authenticated attackers to tamper with content over the network. Admins should apply security updates to prevent unauthorized modification of SharePoint content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels Simulation Mode and Insights Tab
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now support simulation mode to test classification rules without enforcing them, and a new Insights tab shows real-time policy performance metrics. These capabilities help admins validate labeling logic before deployment and monitor ongoing effectiveness.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Network Layer Integration with Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, blocking sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud apps, generative AI platforms, and social media. This preview feature extends DLP enforcement beyond traditional app-level controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Three-Tiered Approval for Priority Cleanup Permanent Deletion
updates.summary: Priority cleanup policies now mandate three separate approvals—from a Priority Cleanup admin, retention manager, and eDiscovery admin—before content can be permanently deleted, significantly reducing accidental data loss risk. This governance gate ensures accountability and cross-functional review.
